elementName: Date or time or period format code

values.name: DDMMYY
values.description: Calendar date: D = Day; M = Month; Y = Year.

values.name: MMDDYY
values.description: Calendar date: M = Month; D = Day; Y = Year.

values.name: DDMMCCYY
values.description: Calendar date C=Century; Y=Year; M=Month; D=Day.

values.name: DDMMCCYYHHMM
values.description: Calendar date and time: C=Century; Y=Year; M=Month; D=Day; H=Hour; M=Minute.

values.name: YYMMDD
values.description: Calendar date: Y = Year; M = Month; D = Day.

values.name: CCYYMMDD
values.description: Calendar date: C = Century ; Y = Year ; M = Month ; D = Day.

values.name: YYWWD
values.description: Calendar week day: Y = Year ; W = Week ; D = Day Week number 01 is always first week of January Day number 1 is always Monday.

values.name: YYDDD
values.description: Calendar day: Y = Year ; D = Day January the first = Day 001 Always start numbering the days of the year from January 1st through December 31st.

values.name: MMDD
values.description: Day of a month: M = Month; D = Day.

values.name: DDD
values.description: Day's number within a specific year: D = Day.

values.name: WW
values.description: Week's number within a specific year: W = Week.

values.name: MM
values.description: Month's number within a specific year: M = Month.

values.name: DD
values.description: Day's number within is a specific month: D = Day.

values.name: YYMMDDHHMM
values.description: Calendar date including time without seconds: Y = Year; M = Month; D = Day; H = Hour; M = Minute.

values.name: YYMMDDHHMMSS
values.description: Calendar date including time with seconds: Y = Year; M = Month; D = Day; H = Hour; m = Minutes = Seconds.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMM
values.description: Calendar date including time with minutes: C=Century; Y=Year; M=Month; D=Day; H=Hour; M=Minutes.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMMSS
values.description: Calendar date including time with seconds: C=Century;Y=Year; M=Month;D=Day;H=Hour;M=Minute;S=Second.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMMZHHMM
values.description: Calendar date including time and time zone expressed in hours and minutes. ZHHMM = time zone given as offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

values.name: YYMMDDHHMMZZZ
values.description: See 201 + Z = Time zone.

values.name: YYMMDDHHMMSSZZZ
values.description: See 202 + Z = Time zone.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMMZZZ
values.description: See 203 plus Z=Time zone.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMMSSZZZ
values.description: See 204 plus Z=Time zone.

values.name: MMDDHHMM
values.description: Month, day, hours, minutes; M = Month; D = Day; H = Hour; M = Minute.

values.name: DDHHMM
values.description: Day, hours, minutes; D = Day; H = Hour; M = Minute.

values.name: HHMM
values.description: Time without seconds: H = Hour; m = Minute.

values.name: HHMMSS
values.description: Time with seconds: H = Hour; m = Minute; s = Seconds.

values.name: HHMMSSZZZ
values.description: See 402 plus Z=Time zone.

values.name: MMMMSS
values.description: Time without hours: m=minutes, s=seconds.

values.name: ZHHMM
values.description: Offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) where Z is plus (+) or minus (-).

values.name: HHMMHHMM
values.description: Time span without seconds: H = Hour; m = Minute;.

values.name: HHMMSS-HHMMSS
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: HHMMSSZZZ-HHMMSSZZZ
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: CC
values.description: Century.

values.name: YY
values.description: Calendar year: Y = Year.

values.name: CCYY
values.description: Calendar year including century: C = Century; Y = Year.

values.name: YYS
values.description: Semester in a calendar year: Y = Year; S = Semester.

values.name: CCYYS
values.description: Semester in a calendar year: C = Century; Y = Year; S = Semester.

values.name: CCYYQ
values.description: Quarter in a calendar year: C = Century; Y = Year; Q = Quarter.

values.name: YYMM
values.description: Month within a calendar year: Y = Year; M = Month.

values.name: CCYYMM
values.description: Month within a calendar year: CC = Century; Y = Year; M = Month.

values.name: YYMMA
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen (A = ten days period).

values.name: CCYYMMA
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen (A = ten days period).

values.name: YYWW
values.description: Week within a calendar year: Y = Year; W = Week 1st week of January = week 01.

values.name: CCYYWW
values.description: Week within a calendar year: CC = Century; Y = Year; W = Week (1st week of January = week 01).

values.name: YY-YY
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: CCYY-CCYY
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: YYS-YYS
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYS-CCYYS
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: YYPYYP
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen (P = period of 4 months).

values.name: CCYYP-CCYYP
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen (P = period of 4 months).

values.name: YYQ-YYQ
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYQ-CCYYQ
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: YYMM-YYMM
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYMM-CCYYMM
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYMMDD-CCYYMMDD
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: YYMMDDHHMM-YYMMDDHHMM
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: YYWW-YYWW
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYWW-CCYYWW
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: YYMMDD-YYMMDD
values.description: Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYMMDD-CCYYMMDD
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen.

values.name: CCYYMMDDHHMM-CCYYMMDDHHMM
values.description: A period of time which includes the century, year, month, day, hour and minute. Format of period to be given in actual message without hyphen.

values.name: DHHMM-DHHMM
values.description: Format of period to be given without hyphen (D=day of the week, 1=Monday; 2=Tuesday; ... 7=Sunday).

values.name: Year
values.description: To indicate a quantity of years.

values.name: Month
values.description: To indicate a quantity of months.

values.name: Week
values.description: To indicate a quantity of weeks.

values.name: Day
values.description: To indicate a quantity of days.

values.name: Hour
values.description: To indicate a quantity of hours.

values.name: Minute
values.description: To indicate a quantity of minutes.

values.name: Second
values.description: To indicate a quantity of seconds.

values.name: Semester
values.description: To indicate a quantity of semesters (six months).

values.name: Four months period
values.description: To indicate a quantity of four months periods.

values.name: Trimester
values.description: To indicate a quantity of trimesters (three months).

values.name: Half month
values.description: To indicate a quantity of half months.

values.name: Ten days
values.description: To indicate a quantity of ten days periods.

values.name: Day of the week
values.description: Numeric representation of the day (Monday = 1).

values.name: Working days
values.description: Number of working days.
